items.title: Show HN: Fastbrowse, Browser agent that picks clicks with a System One model
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN, I'm Furqan founder of Nebula. We've spent a lot of time building, using and breaking browser agents. The main issues we ran into were costs and speed. So we built our own and open sourced it.
It's pretty simple, give it a task and it drives Chrome faster and cheaper than the alternatives.
At each step it lists the page's elements instead of screenshots. This means it can't click on buttons that aren't there.
We use System One models (currently Jev), which keeps costs extremely low, around

Balk is a baseball game. Things like MLB Showdown and other baseball games captured my attention growing up, but never really filled the void of a game. They were fun to look at and scheme, but the game itself was missing something. I think baseball lends itself really well to game design. items.title: Show HN: News article bias detector tool
items.contentSnippet:
I built a news article bias detector tool. You paste the link of any article into it and it will give the article a bias rating from 1 - 7. It scores based on loaded wording in the article, the acknowledgement of different perspectives and if they're justified. It checks for vital information that the article leaves out and allows users to dispute the ratings given, it's in the niche of ground news and All Sides. Looking for feedback.
